description: This file declares functions and structures related to time domain resource management for TDD operation in a 5G NR context, including generation of candidate lists for PDSCH and PUSCH resources, and calculation of minimum symbols for PDSCH considering PDCCH configurations.

methods.name: generate_k1_candidates
methods.description: Generates a list of k1 candidate values for PDSCH-to-HARQ timing based on TDD configuration.

methods.name: calculate_minimum_pdsch_symbol
methods.description: Calculates the minimum symbol index available for PDSCH, avoiding collision with PDCCH symbols.

methods.name: generate_dedicated_pdsch_td_res_list
methods.description: Creates a list of PDSCH time domain resource allocations considering available symbols.

methods.name: generate_dedicated_pusch_td_res_list
methods.description: Creates a list of UE dedicated PUSCH time domain resource allocations for TDD operation.
